574:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...So you managed to shake off the $$アークセイバー$$s and rejoin us.」

574:t_1:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Judging by the situation, we were caught in a $$時空震動$$ and sent to $$インサラウム$$... its past, at that.」

574:t_1:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So this is before $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ went out of control? Hell, before $$ガイオウ$$ even showed up...」

574:t_1:8.en:
$$トロワ$$
「From how the $$アークセイバー$$s responded, that seems to be the case.」

574:t_1:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「We didn't just jump to a parallel world. We went back in time, too...」

574:t_1:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I know. You don't have to say it. I'm probably the one who caused all this.」

574:t_1:14.en:
$$青山$$
「You had that kind of crazy power!?」

574:t_1:15.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Was it the $$スフィア$$'s power?」

574:t_1:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...It seems to be something else.」

574:t_1:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But ever since we were stopping $$レナード$$'s $$時空震動$$, I'd been vaguely wondering...」

574:t_1:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If I were going to remake the world, where would I start...?」

574:t_1:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「And your answer was the history of $$インサラウム$$'s destruction?」

574:t_1:20.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm surprised. You didn't pick wiping out your debt.」

574:t_1:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll handle that myself. Wiping out something I did isn't my style.」

574:t_1:22.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's typical of you, but since it's about debt, you don't sound cool at all.」

574:t_1:23.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then your desire to stop $$インサラウム$$'s destruction transported us here...?」

574:t_1:24.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems some unusually generous god granted my irresponsible wish.」

574:t_1:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「So what do we do? Do we stay here and fight $$ガイオウ$$ when he eventually arrives?」

574:t_1:28.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is a difficult question.」

574:t_1:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I know I'm the one who caused this, but I still wonder if we outsiders, who aren't gods, have any right to meddle with how this world exists.」

574:t_1:30.en:
$n
「But even if this is a parallel world, I can't stand watching Earth get destroyed right in front of us.」

574:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I understand how you feel, too...」

574:t_1:32.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「At the same time, we need to figure out how to get back to our own world.」

574:t_1:33.en:
$$青山$$
「$$インサラウム$$ has dimensional science. They should be able to transport us, but...」

574:t_1:34.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Dimensional science... That means 《$$アンブローン$$》 $$ジウス$$...」

574:t_1:35.en:
$$いぶき$$
「The captains seem to be contacting $$インサラウム$$'s royal family to ask for their help, but...」

574:t_1:36.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then will they also warn them about $$アンブローン$$'s ambitions?」

574:t_1:39.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Because we can't be sure this world is the past of the $$インサラウム$$ we know.」

574:t_1:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「For all we know, $$アンブローン$$ could be a kindly old lady who adores the prince.」

574:t_1:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And while we're at it, we can't even be sure $$ガイオウ$$ will come here.」

574:t_1:42.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's correct. Our arrival here may already have made this a different world from that $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:43.en:
$$トロワ$$
「So it branched off into a parallel world.」

574:t_1:44.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then from here on, things'll turn out however they turn out.」

574:t_1:45.en:
$$カトル$$
「Even if we stop $$ガイオウ$$, that will simply become a new history for $$インサラウム$$.」

574:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So whatever we do, we can't save the $$インサラウム$$ of the $$マルグリット$$ and $$ユーサー$$ we knew...」

574:t_1:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's probably how it should be... We give everything we've got to what's in front of us because we can't do it over.」

574:t_1:49.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A god's power is more than we deserve, especially a guy like me.」

574:t_1:50.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's true. If you could erase your debt, you'd lose your reason to live.」

574:t_1:51.en:
$$マリー$$
「A-$$アレルヤ$$... Aren't you going a little too far...?」

574:t_1:52.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's fine, $$マリー$$. He's right.」

574:t_1:53.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... using $$クロウ$$'s debt as an example is a bit much, but what he's saying is right.」

574:t_1:54.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Being able to return to the past is the same as robbing the future of its meaning.」

574:t_1:55.en:
$$刹那$$
「The past is already behind us. We rejected the $$時の牢獄$$, so let's focus on moving forward.」

574:t_1:56.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I finally got to see you again, Big Sis, and now this happens...」

574:t_1:57.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You don't have time to mope, $$ノリコ$$. This is when you need to stay calm.」

574:t_1:60.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You're $$ノノ$$, then. $$ノリコ$$ told me most of your story.」

574:t_1:61.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$, the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

574:t_1:62.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We both pilot $$バスターマシン$$s... Well, you're a $$バスターマシン$$ yourself, but would you be my friend?」

574:t_1:64.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm counting on you from now on. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

574:t_1:66.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you trading in your Big Sis?」

574:t_1:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$!? $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis will forever be...」

574:t_1:69.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened between you and Princess, but hurry up and make up with her.」

574:t_1:70.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the $$バラの女王$$ saying the $$バスターマシン$$ pilots from our time have no spirit.」

574:t_1:72.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you, $$ノノ$$.」

574:t_1:73.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You don't have to worry, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the best team after you and me.」

574:t_1:74.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(That's right, isn't it, $$ノノ$$, $$ラルク$$...?)

574:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm sorry, everyone. My careless wish ended up dragging $c all over the place.」

574:t_1:76.en:
$$青山$$
「You're damn right. When we get home, you're treating us to something.」

574:t_1:77.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You mean I'm paying for everyone in $c?」

574:t_1:79.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Am I paying for the maintenance and support crews, too?」

574:t_1:81.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I... think I'll spend the rest of my life in $$インサラウム$$...」
